newsitem.title: EGYPT: Six people burn to death in car accident in Egypt.
newsitem.headline: Six people burn to death in car accident in Egypt.

text.p: Six people were burnt to death in a car accident in northeast Egypt, a government newspaper said on Friday.
Five other people were seriously wounded, al-Gomhuria said.
The accident took place in the province of Sharqiya, some 100 km (30 miles) northeast of Cairo, when a taxi collided with a truck coming in the opposite direction, the newspaper added.
It did not say when the accident took place.
